exposure: preterm rupture of membranes after 35 weeks
outcome: Time interval from induction to active labor
cohort: 904 women with preterm rupture of membranes after 35 weeks and an unfavorable cervix
finding: Vaginal dinoprostone used for labor induction in preterm rupture of membranes seems to be more effective for vaginal delivery than vaginal misoprostol (50 µg).
mod_finding: The study found that vaginal dinoprostone use for labor induction in preterm rupture of membranes led to a higher vaginal delivery rate compared to vaginal misoprostol.
